10 Some product information that may be useful during your search When looking for a new pallet truck or manual stacker, it is important to choose the right type of wheels depending on your activities and working environment. Let us help you out. Material of the wheels Quick-lift vs double-action pump With a quick-lift pump, one single pump movement is enough to lift up your pallet from the ground. The quick- lift function can be used for loads of max 125 kg. And, in addition to this, a stacker can also be equipped with a double-action pump. This means that you can choose between the foot pump or hand pump to lift your load. Single or tandem fork wheels Polyurethane (PU) wheels can be used for many in- and outdoor applications. These wheels are quiet and very shock-absorbing, as a result of which they are very suitable for both hard and soft surfaces. ‘Single’ means that both forks contain one fork wheel, suitable for solid floors. The pallet truck is easy to turn and the forks have nose wheels* for smoother transportation. With single fork wheels, you’re even able to enter your pallet sideways. ‘Tandem’ means that both forks contain two fork wheels. This is better for transportation on uneven floors. Your load will be divided over both wheels, resulting in less rapid wear of the wheels. * Most of our pallet trucks are equipped with nose wheels, located on the front edge of each fork. This allows for a clean pallet entry and exit. Rubber wheels are frequently used in industrial applications (warehouses, workshops and the transport sector) and only used as steering wheels. They are silent and roll easily. Nylon wheels are often light and have a high shock resistance. They are resistant against water and chemical cleaning agents. As these wheels are less shock- absorbing, they are slightly louder during transport.

11 CE marking, what is it? A lot of products need to meet the European legislation for free marketability in the European Economic Area. Every product that meets these requirements regarding health, safety and environmental protection standards, is provided with a CE certificate. What does this mean for non-European countries? Products with a CE certificate can be sold in the European Economic Area, but many of them can also be sold in other countries. Check which regulations apply to your country regarding these product groups. Products without a CE certificate When a product does not have a CE certificate, you don’t need to question the quality of the product. It just means that the European Commission has no specific regulations for it. Every product we offer meets our requirements. Perma-Lock Perma-Lock is a type of spray head, designed exclusively for CRC. The spray head has a dual-purpose design, allowing you to switch between a wide spray jet in the “down” position, or precision spraying in the “up” position. This allows for a meticulous application of the product; a feature that is often desired in food-processing environments. You can find these sprays on page 322 in this catalogue. NSF International® This is the only independent, third-party organisation that offers product registration for non-food compounds such as lubricants, cleaning agents and water treatment chemicals used in food and beverage processing. All products that are NSF-certified through their manufacturer, are marked with the NSF logo in this catalogue. NSF uses a number of codes for different purposes: A8 Degreasers/carbon removers K1 Non-processing area solvent cleaners H1 General – incidental contact lubricant K2 Electronic instrument cleaners K3 Adhesives/glue removers A7 Metal polishes – non-food contact C1 General non-processing area product H2 General – no contact lubricant P1 Miscellaneous 11

2. WEIGHING SYSTEMS 2. WEIGHING SYSTEMS 123 123 2.1. WEIGHING PALLET TRUCKS Just think about warehouses, ports ... Every day or multiple times a week, heavy shipments arrive that must be weighed for inspection. Boxes and drums are first dragged from boats or lorries to a pair of scales, after which they leave for their destination. A tough job that often leads to backache. Wouldn’t it be better if moving and weighing the goods could be done in one single action? The weighing pallet truck is the ideal solution! This device operates in the same way as a normal pallet truck, but is equipped with a weighing system that is integrated into the forks. 2. WEIGHING SYSTEMS
